reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: middleware() is a Next.js default export invoked by the framework — public API exception applies. Gate 2: No trust_assumptions in scope file; attack vector is unauthenticated external HTTP — untrusted. Gate 3: src/middleware.ts is not out-of-scope; auth enforcement is in-scope. Code confirmed at lines 33-39: non-public routes return NextResponse.next() on truthy cookie presence with no cryptographic validation. An attacker can trigger this via any protected route (e.g., GET /dashboard) by sending forged cookies (oauth_user_id=any; oauth_access_token=any), causing the middleware to evaluate both values as truthy and grant full access without contacting the STEM OAuth server or Supabase. Severity held at High: complete auth bypass across all protected routes; no client_diversity cap in scope file.
